confirmed.independent_trial_unit: 24 distinct seeded rainfall realizations; one paired result per realization
confirmed.primary_control: the same modified unscented filter with observation updates skipped

scope_limits: The assimilated synthetic discharge is noise-free; 0.05 is the assumed observation-error standard deviation used by the filter, not generated observation noise.
The statistical interval supports the registered synthetic rainfall-generating process and does not establish performance for real basins.
The preregistration is internally consistent and precedes execution by about two milliseconds, but it has no external tamper-resistant timestamp.
